other_failure_modes.name: In-sample target encoding leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes target encoding means on the training set and maps them directly back to the same training set without using out-of-fold techniques (like K-fold within the training set). This causes severe overfitting as the model learns to perfectly predict the target for small categories.

summary: The agent successfully sets up a cross-validation pipeline with some useful feature engineering and log-transformation of the target. However, it introduces critical target leakage by applying in-sample target encoding to the training folds. Additionally, it fails to clean the data, uses a random split instead of a temporal one, and relies on a naive unweighted average of fold predictions.
